name: tgchats-local
description: Connect Codex to a self-hosted local tgchats Telegram MCP runtime.

interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to a user-operated tgchats MCP process for local Telegram and CRM workflows. This package requires local Telegram API credentials, session storage, and optional Postgres and AI configuration; it does not connect to Chiho's hosted service.
defaultPrompt: Show my recent local Telegram chats.
Find follow-ups in my local Telegram data.
Organize local Telegram chats with tags and tasks.
